item.title: Member of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission ousted in dispute over antisemitism
item.description: The ousted member, Carrie Prejean Boller, had defended commentator Candace Owens.

item.title: Detroit Country Day coach, players react to school joining CHSL
item.description: In boys hoops alone, the Catholic High School League is only going to strengthen itself with the addition of Detroit Country Day next season.

item.title: ‘Let’s do it’: How Tigers owner Chris Ilitch backed bold last-minute move
item.description: When Scott Harris, the Detroit Tigers’ president of baseball operations, dialed up team owner Christopher Ilitch to ask his blessing for a massive investment in free-agent pitcher Framber Valdez, there was one complication.

item.title: For Framber Valdez, Tigers felt like family from the start
item.description: Framber Valdez’s family attended his introductory press conference on Wednesday, with even the little ones dressed to the nines in suits and ties. His baseball family, his new rotation mates with the Detroit Tigers, were also there, albeit not so well-dressed. They had just come in off the practice fields and were in sweats or baseball apparel.

item.title: Michiganders Madison Chock and Evan Bates settle for silver in surprise ice dance finish
item.description: A single tear rolled down Madison Chock’s face. A silver medal hung around her neck. It was a bittersweet prize. Chock and Evan Bates, the three-time world ice dance champions, settled for second place in their fourth Olympics together, falling 1.43 points behind France’s Laurence Fournier Beaudry and Guillaume Cizeron on Wednesday at Milano Ice Skating Arena.

item.title: Justin Verlander is back. Here’s what else stood out on Tigers’ first day
item.description: Justin Verlander and Kenley Jansen have never been teammates before, but they share the familiarity that comes from spending a combined 35 years in Major League Baseball. Verlander, a future Hall-of-Fame starter, and Jansen, a four-time All-Star closer, are free-agent acquisitions who greeted each other like old friends in the Tigers’ clubhouse on Wednesday.

item.title: Betts scores 22 points and No. 2 UCLA stretches win streak to 18 games by overpowering MSU, 86-63
item.description: Lauren Betts had 22 points, seven rebounds and five assists and No. 2 UCLA pushed its winning streak to 18 games by thumping No. 13 Michigan State 86-63 on Wednesday night.

item.title: Cunningham scores 28 points, Pistons overcome suspensions to rout Raptors 113-95
item.description: Cade Cunningham scored 28 points, Paul Reed had 16 of his 22 in the first quarter and the Detroit Pistons beat the Toronto Raptors 113-95 on Wednesday night in the final game before the All-Star break for both teams.

item.title: Cason leads second-half rally as No. 2 Michigan knocks off Northwestern, 87-75
item.description: L.J. Cason scored 13 of his 18 points after halftime, helping No. 2 Michigan rally for an 87-75 victory over Nick Martinelli and Northwestern on Wednesday night.

item.description: Romeo wins Team Wrestling District at Rochester Sontey Creek
